source_summary: Short evidence rows are the lean boundary between Codex research and deterministic HSConfig generation: each row identifies one source, one claim kind, card mentions, stance, short evidence text, and source confidence.
current_truth: HSConfig should not store long guide prose in runtime packages or fixtures. The source-builder layer can be aggressive in collecting evidence, but the deterministic drafter must resolve every card mention to exact deck CardIDs before the claim can support source-backed readiness.
repo_alignment: The repository now has a draft-source-documents command and source_document_drafter module that convert evidence_rows into source_documents.json and report unresolved mentions.
implementation_implication: Keep evidence rows intentionally small and append-only. Use source_document_draft_report.json as the first operator check when a guide mention cannot be resolved to a deck card.
gaps_or_risks: Evidence rows still depend on Codex/research quality; bad guide interpretation can create a structured but wrong claim.
Unresolved card names must never be silently lowered to runtime config.
recommended_action: Use hsconfig source-manifest before research, collect short evidence rows, and run hsconfig draft-source-documents before research-deck.
